presets.title: 雨夜霓虹海报
presets.prompt: 雨夜东京街头，霓虹灯牌倒映在湿地面上，主体：{主体}。青橙电影色调，浅景深，35mm 胶片颗粒，竖版海报构图，上方留出标题空间。
presets.promptEn: Rainy Tokyo street at night, neon signs mirrored on wet pavement, subject: {subject}. Teal-orange cinematic grade, shallow depth of field, 35mm grain, vertical poster composition with title space at the top.
presets.desc: 暗色底 + 一处暖光，适合做活动海报。
presets.descEn: Dark base with one warm light. Good for event posters.

presets.title: 清晨薄雾山谷
presets.prompt: 清晨的高山草甸，薄雾贴着地面，远处是层层退去的山脊，第一缕阳光落在{焦点}。宽幅构图，空气感强，低饱和青绿与暖金，参考大画幅风光摄影。
presets.promptEn: Alpine meadow at dawn, mist hugging the ground, layered ridges fading into the distance, first sunlight hitting the {subject}. Wide composition, strong aerial perspective, desaturated teal-green and warm gold, large-format landscape photography.
presets.desc: 无参考图也能用的纯文字场景。
presets.descEn: Pure text-to-image scene that needs no reference.
